title: The Indistractable Workplace
hook: A specimen cassette rack sits beside an escalation code card. A workplace routine is a promise people can plan around.
counterintuition: The easy mistake is to imagine a utopian quiet office instead of concrete shared practices people can rely on. The sharper move is to turn attention-friendly culture into shared routines that make focused work, responsiveness, and recovery predictable.

keyTakeaway: Turn attention-friendly culture into shared routines that make focused work, responsiveness, and recovery predictable so prior intent beats the nearest convincing escape.

breakdown.fastRead: A lab team needs quiet slide review and a fast path when a case is urgent. A focused workplace does not ask people to guess. It sets shared rules for deep work, quick help, and rest after breaks. Each person should know when to wait, where to raise an alert, and how work resumes. Culture becomes real when the routine survives a busy Tuesday.
